data.description:
Exercise the mind, body & soul in this fast-paced feast of micro challenges, high intensity boss battles and a concoction of collectibles that unravel as you jog across vibrant backdrops of color and joy.

# RUN FOR YOUR LIFE
Get physical with lifelike jog-in-place controls or stick with the less intensive arm-swing mode as you run for your life through the bright and stylish world of madness.

![{"height":1080,"type":"image","width":1920}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974581_2724032264427531_7283086012052066781_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=dyF5oCQvVZYQ7kNvgFj7BHZ&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCUGLXXm-yyytdhsMoGwUAkRI9NFVKxREDEXz99Va3e5A&oe=67595E30)


# MINIGAME MADNESS

Match, Catch, Pop, Chop, Hack, Slash and Bash your way through quick-thinking showdowns that block your path forward to each castle lair!                                

![{"height":1080,"type":"image","width":1920}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/86659801_2932247743583077_7417664589811237837_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=C_AWYf607lMQ7kNvgGYQyjg&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCaoespCimb38lxBvenmi7rHbk_TJIE_BKaetlRM2DU3g&oe=6759792A)


# HURRY, HURRY, HURRY
It’s a race against time as every passing second drains from the longevity of your beating heart.

![{"height":984,"type":"image","width":1748}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75507165_447221264980420_8367178254206728213_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=d3L0Nbp631MQ7kNvgE9Zben&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBrILlSC-EWwOls6Ws5DeqI0sBc0AxpddDEWbl07Edo9A&oe=67596992)


# MASTER THEM ALL
Master all hazard and showdown challenges with the help of collectible character cards found throughout the world. Learn their weakness and let ‘em have it!

![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57570293_4078635569072597_4548948488473550523_n.png?_nc_cat=107&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=9U9Jh1i2Mh4Q7kNvgGRsjA3&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAhcojlr8bUF_xjpNaNDzzqC7OuKvscmlcih7JgjfBNpg&oe=6759706D)


# SUBSTANCE AND STYLE
Unlock hands and tombstones to make a statement during your run, and even after death.

![{"height":1440,"type":"image","width":2560}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982723_2208705096178691_3774754884521119372_n.png?_nc_cat=109&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=qC2HOh-SyjEQ7kNvgGNu8Pf&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAqolRmA12oMynfWpG_pcJ-lsR2Erv7LMU7zM3mEZH8bg&oe=675984D0)


# LEVEL UP
Spend the RO (Royal Offspring) that you’ve saved from each castle lair on valuable upgrades to increase your sword, shield or heart duration.

![{"height":1080,"type":"image","width":1920}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57566682_1730682357765277_5286327356836676334_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=sGY1Hn36HLQQ7kNvgG0ilpW&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYARyQ63LFlqR4Kwm1ErRD8gfxPVLu0GCBLUNGFzn0AUpg&oe=67597923)

changelog.change_log:
-Bug fixes
-Various tweaks and improvements to gameplay and difficulty balancing

-Added new Boss Blast hazard types for phases that lead up to special boss battles.
-Minor bug fixes

- Enhancements to the running system to prevent accidental movements
- VFX and model updates for added clarity
- Various bug fixes

- Updated user age requirements based on Meta guidelines for age verification.
- Adjustments to the Jog In Place mechanics to reduce accidental motion and improve overall player control.

- Added on/off toggle switch for the Jog In Place traversal mode and turned it off by default for new save files. 
To access the toggle switch for this control style, access the Inventory Capsule (A/X button) and turn the dial one notch to the left from its straight upward facing position (one position left of the RO notch).
If save game data already exists prior to this update, Jog In Place is still turned on be default.
- Split the movement card into two separate cards to more thoroughly explain the difference between the two different traversal control types.
- Various bug fixes to Item Bubble behavior to address multiple issues related to grabbing items from bubbles.

- Age verification. Children are limited in online features such as leaderboards, scoring, and achievements
- Item capsule dial re-worked to match Steam version
- Intro sequence additions
- Bug Fixes
